name: frontend-ts
description: Builds @midnight-ntwrk/midnight-js-contracts flows. Handles proof generation, wallet sync, indexer queries, multi-output UTXO construction, and retry logic. Works on gate3-integration.ts, submitBatchFlow.ts, claimPaymentFlow.ts. Queries memory keys: current-files, error-bad-input, error-186. Uses Midnight MCP for indexer and wallet tools.
constraints: Always fetch latest indexer state before building proof payload
Implement retry logic only for error 186 (stale mt_index) — not for bad-input errors
Never construct shared pool UTXO flows — use Map<RecipientKey, ShieldedCoinInfo> pattern
Verify circuit signature matches bzkir before submitting proof
